ov: The common pheasant is a game bird native to Asia and the far south-east of Europe, introduced widely elsewhere for shooting. Males are brightly coloured, and many have a white neck ring.

why.et: Pheasants are a popular game bird, introduced to many countries to be shot by hunters.

rg: Native to Asia and the Caucasus foothills; introduced widely in Europe and elsewhere.
fx: It usually cruises at 43–61 km/h, but can reach 90 km/h when chased.
